meta.name: Sync warehouse stock from SFTP to GoHighLevel and iPaper with alerts

name: Warehouse Automation Hub – FTP → GHL + iPaper + Email

parameters.content:
## 🏭 Warehouse Automation Hub – FTP Stock Sync to GHL & iPaper

### How it works
Three times a day, the workflow connects to the warehouse SFTP server, lists the `/outbound/stock/` directory, and downloads the latest CSV file. The CSV is parsed and each row is validated and transformed — checking required fields, normalising numeric types, and flagging any item with stock ≤ 10 as a low-stock alert. Valid products are split into batches of 50 and synced in parallel to two systems: GoHighLevel (product + stock update) and iPaper (catalogue sync). After all batches are processed, an acknowledgement CSV is written back to the SFTP server at `/inbound/acknowledgements/`. If low-stock items were found, an alert email goes out. If any rows failed validation, an error report email is sent. The run is logged to execution custom data throughout.

### Setup steps
1. Add your **SFTP credential** to all three FTP nodes.
2. Set the following **environment variables** in your n8n instance: `IPAPER_API_URL`, `GHL_BASE_URL`, and `NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL`.
3. Update the recipient email addresses in `Email - Low Stock Alert` and `Email - Error Notification`.
4. Add authentication headers to the `GHL - Update Product and Stock` and `iPaper - Sync Catalogue` HTTP nodes (GHL Bearer token, iPaper API key).
5. Confirm the SFTP paths `/outbound/stock/` and `/inbound/acknowledgements/` match your warehouse server layout.
6. Activate the schedule trigger.

nodes.name: Section – SFTP File Discovery & CSV Download

parameters.content:
## 📁 SFTP File Discovery & CSV Download
Lists the warehouse SFTP `/outbound/stock/` directory, filters for `.csv` files only, and downloads the most recent one. Running 3× daily ensures stock levels stay current throughout the trading day.

## ✅ CSV Validation & Transformation
Parses the CSV, checks each row for required fields, normalises quantities and prices to correct types, and flags items where stock is at or below 10 units. Errors are tracked in execution custom data and don't stop the rest of the batch from processing.

nodes.name: Section – Parallel Sync to GHL & iPaper

parameters.content:
## 🔄 Parallel Sync: GHL + iPaper
Valid products are split into batches of 50. Each batch syncs to two systems simultaneously: GoHighLevel (product info + stock level) and iPaper (catalogue update). Processing in parallel keeps sync times short even for large catalogues.

## 📤 Acknowledgement, Alerts & Completion Log
After all batches finish: writes an ACK CSV back to SFTP, logs the run summary to execution custom data, sends a low-stock alert email if any items are near zero, and sends a validation error report if any rows were rejected.

## 🔑 Credentials & Environment Variables
- **SFTP Account** — all three FTP nodes
- `IPAPER_API_URL` — iPaper base URL env var
- `GHL_BASE_URL` — GHL API base URL env var
- `NOTIFY_FROM_EMAIL` — sender address env var
- Add auth headers for GHL (Bearer token) and iPaper (API key) in the HTTP nodes.
